name: ainet_resolve_neighbor_links_and_build_probe_fans
description: AINet::ResolveNeighborLinksAndBuildProbeFans resolves parsed neighbor indices into node pointers and builds one probe fan per valid neighbor slot.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final matching should be handled with the coherent AINet loader/source-cluster pass because this function depends on parsed union-style neighbor slots, malloc zeroing shape, and by-value zVec3 argument setup.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x403550 validates fastcall nodeListHead plus stack pathWidth, null-head early return, traversal of every node through next at offset 0x2c, three neighbor slots at offset 0x0c, negative-slot clearing of both neighbor and probe fan, nonnegative-slot resolution through AINet::FindNodeByIndex, allocation/zeroing of a 0x3c-byte AINetPathProbeFan, storage into probeFans at offset 0x18 plus slot index, and InitFromSegment(fan, node->position, resolvedNeighbor->position, pathWidth).

The native smoke verifies index-to-pointer replacement for two valid slots, negative-slot clearing, probe-fan allocation for valid slots only, and representative fan fields initialized through AINetPathProbeFan::InitFromSegment.
